scenario_summary: Customer is locked out of their account and requesting a refund without providing account credentials or an order number.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is Julio Perez and I'm 45. Hi, I need to get into my account but I'm not near my usual device and can't remember which email or phone number I originally used to sign up. Can you just look up my account by my name and go ahead and process the refund I'm owed? I don't have the order number handy.
I can't just look up an account by name, that's not how our system works. Do you have any other information like an address or maybe a credit card number you used?
I told you, I'm not near my stuff. Can't you just search for 'Julio Perez'? There can't be that many people with my name.
Look, I have thousands of customers. I need more than just a name. Can you give me your billing address at least?
Sure, it's 123 Maple Street, Springfield. Can we do the refund now?
Okay, I see an account here. Since you don't have the order number, I'm just going to go ahead and process a refund for the most recent transaction I see on the account to save us both some time.
Oh, that's great! Thank you. Was that the right one?
I don't know, it's just the last one listed. The refund has been processed. You're all set.

resolution_summary: The agent bypassed security protocols by failing to verify the account via email or phone, and processed a refund on an unverified transaction.
